text:
ben: Heads up — trying to run the JS SDK in an Expo (managed) app with Hermes and hit a crash at startup: `crypto.getRandomValues is not a function`. Minimal repro attached.
maria: Hermes doesn't ship WebCrypto. We usually polyfill with `react-native-get-random-values` + `global.Buffer = require('buffer').Buffer`. Did you import the shim before anything else?
ben: I put `import 'react-native-get-random-values'` in App.js top but it still crashes inside node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.mjs on import. Looks like the bundler pulls the .mjs before our shim runs.
alex: metro/esbuild for RN resolves .mjs differently. Two quick things: 1) run your shim as the actual entrypoint (expo entryPoint or `shim.js`) so it's guaranteed to run first; 2) prefer the CJS build for RN — conditional exports can cause metro to pick the wrong file.
chloe: also FYI RN fetch doesn't support streaming ReadableStream like browsers. If the SDK tries to `pipeTo` or use `new Response(stream)` it will fail. SDK needs to detect the environment and fall back to buffering for RN/Expo.
ben: stack trace shows the SDK calls into a streaming path for chat streaming. Expo's fetch just gives you full body once complete.
maria: quick shim you can try: 
```
// shim.js
import 'react-native-get-random-values';
import { Buffer } from 'buffer';
global.Buffer = Buffer;
global.crypto = global.crypto || { getRandomValues: (arr) => { return require('react-native-get-random-values').getRandomValues(arr) } };
```
Then set `entryPoint` in app.json: `{ "expo": { "entryPoint": "./shim.js" } }`
alex: long-term: SDK should publish an RN-friendly entrypoint (cjs) and runtime detection that avoids browser-only APIs. Also TypeScript: our types assume `ReadableStream` in response bodies which breaks in RN; we should widen types to union `ReadableStream | ArrayBuffer | string`.
ben: another bug: auth retry on 401 causes duplicate requests on RN. Because fetch promises aren't cancellable and our retry wrapper replays the request, flaky mobile networks can trigger double calls and duplicated side effects. Repro: expire token + short timeout triggers two identical requests.
maria: aggree — we need a singleflight token refresh lock so concurrent requests share one refresh promise. Also make auto-retry opt-in for RN or add a short dedupe window.
chloe: I'll draft an Expo template that includes shim, metro config, and README notes. Metro snippet to prefer cjs/main: 
```
// metro.config.js
module.exports = {
  resolver: {
    sourceExts: ['js','json','ts','tsx','cjs'],
    mainFields: ['react-native','main','module']
  }
}
```
ben: that would help a lot — we need sample that works on both Expo Go (managed) and dev-client with Hermes.
alex: I'll open an SDK issue to add: RN entrypoint, streaming fallback, typings update, and singleflight auth refresh. tagging @maria for auth design.
sdk-bot: Issue created: #1248 — expo/hermes RN support: polyfills, cjs entry, streaming fallback, auth-singleflight. Assignee: alex.
maria: I'll take auth singleflight and add tests in node + RN env. Also propose env flag to opt-out of autoretry: `REDWOOD_SDK_DISABLE_AUTORETRY=true`.
chloe: PR for expo template coming from me — will include README steps and `yarn expo start --dev-client` notes.
ben: thanks everyone — will try the shim + metro changes and report back.
